overview_intro: Included in [Framework 0.4.0](https://github.com/DooDesch-Mods/MMORPGTycoon2-ModFramework/releases/tag/v0.4.0). New gameplay tools are experimental. World-changing Lua gameplay operations currently run in singleplayer.

features.name: Lua mods and reload
features.scope: Use a text editor; reload scripts without restarting. A rejected replacement keeps the previous mod running. [Start here](docs/quickstart.md).

features.name: Native C++ plugins
features.scope: Build with the native SDK. Plugin updates require a game restart. [SDK guide](docs/reference/native.md).

features.name: In-game mod apps
features.scope: Open Lua and native mods through the central Mods window, with optional game-desktop icons. Lua apps can use native windows, PNGs and document layouts. [Lua app guide](docs/recipes/lua-apps.md).

features.name: Static GLB scenery
features.scope: Import static models and textures into the scenery catalog. Keep required packs installed for your saves. [Scenery guide](docs/guides/scenery.md).

features.name: Camera, objects and world actions
features.scope: Use the documented camera, time, object and checked world-operation APIs. [API reference](docs/reference/index.md).

features.name: Character design
features.scope: Create character definitions and variants; edit stats, appearance, weapons and abilities from Lua. [Gameplay guide](docs/experimental/gameplay.md).

features.name: Actors, quests and Monster Zones
features.scope: Place, move and remove supported NPCs, Monsters and Bosses. Edit quests, Boss phases and Monster Zones, including native paint and erase tools.

features.name: Dungeon tools
features.scope: Edit Dungeon cells, themes, lighting, paint, gizmos and instances. Building operations use the active editable Dungeon template.

features.name: Modular building tools
features.scope: Place modular prefabs, read layouts, add or remove blocks and entrances, and use the supported native Undo and Redo routes.

features.name: Terrain, paths and scenery tools
features.scope: Edit Regions and terrain, build paths and curved walls, and paint, group or transform scenery through native game operations.

features.name: Management and development tools
features.scope: Manage fees, loans, staff, marketing, game releases, research projects and server networks from Lua.

features.name: Native patches
features.scope: Observe named game calls with ordered callbacks and conflict diagnostics. [Patch guide](docs/experimental/patches.md).

features.name: Vortex installation
features.scope: Manage the player Runtime and mod ZIPs using the separate Vortex Extension. [Install guide](integrations/vortex/README.md).

features.name: Editor types and agent docs
features.scope: Generated Lua types, complete examples and a versioned machine contract. [Agent entry point](docs/agents/start.md).

features.name: Multiplayer mods
features.scope: Run the separate Multiplayer mod with its matching requirements. Other mods need their own synchronization; the new Lua gameplay mutations currently run in singleplayer.

features.name: Animated models and C#
features.scope: Future extensions. The current release uses static scenery, Lua and native C++.
